ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent that detects cross-protocol yield discrepancies between tokenized real-world asset (RWA) vaults and DeFi lending pools, executing automated rebalancing strategies via Multipli.fi integration.
ideas.title: MultipliRWA Yield Arbitrage Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core focus of the title sponsor Multipli.fi by building a functional financial utility around DeFi and RWA tokenization.

ideas.pitch: A Zero-Knowledge proof verification pipeline using Noir circuits to privately verify institutional reserve backing for tokenized RWAUSD without exposing sensitive treasury asset addresses.
ideas.title: zkRWA-Proof
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages advanced cryptography (ZK) which appeals to judges looking for hard engineering challenges rather than simple wrapper applications.

ideas.pitch: A high-performance quantitative backtesting and execution engine optimized for perpetual DEX markets, featuring automated parameter optimization via historical volatility benchmarks.
ideas.title: QuantGrid Arbitrage Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the quantitative strategies track and implements rigorous data benchmarking inspired by systematic trading hackathon winners.

ideas.pitch: An options portfolio risk management tool powered by gradient-boosted decision trees that calculates real-time delta-hedging adjustments during extreme market volatility.
ideas.title: AI Options Risk Shield
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines machine learning with complex financial derivatives, mimicking successful hackathon entries that tackle specialized trading risk mechanics.

ideas.title: Autonomous Drone Fleet Settlement
